topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Hybrid beamforming, combining analog and digital processing, ensures consistent LOS connectivity. Adaptive beamforming and precoding mitigate frequency selective fading and Rician distributed fading. Integrating machine learning-based channel prediction and beam tracking algorithms optimizes resource allocation, reduces interference, and improves capacity.
reference_context: Aeronautical ad-hoc networks face challenges in maintaining stable connectivity due to high velocity and dynamic flight formations.
